Reality Fracture

Witness the conclusion of Jace’s arc as his ultimate plan comes to fruition. Celebrate and lament the last chapter of this complicated character—get the whole story to experience a finale years in the making.

Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive

An artificial being is born. A new Multiverse is made.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt

Tam grapples with her purpose, Liliana is visited by a familiar face, and the Theorist peers into the future.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both

Ajani and Chandra recruit a reclusive Planeswalker to help them take down the Theorist.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 4: Oh, Sweetie

On Innistrad, Tam speaks with an ancient entity; in Hexhaven, Ajani, Chandra, Vraska, and Garruk confront the Theorist.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You

The Theorist defeats his former allies, again and again and again.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition

Tam learns what will become of her friends if the Theorist succeeds; Vraska learns what will become of Jace if they stop him.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces

A prison break, and a break with reality.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open

Vraska finds the final three aberrations. The Theorist plunges forward with his plan to merge the Multiverses.

Read More

Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid

Ajani, Chandra, Vraska, and Garruk face off against their doubles.

Read More

The Echoverse collapses.
